entries.title: Reporting Facility Issues — Eptura Work Order Requests (maintenance, repairs, broken equipment)
entries.content:
To report a facility issue (something broken, leaking, clogged, dirty, not working, or needing repair or maintenance — e.g. a broken or clogged toilet, sink, urinal or shower, restroom/locker room problems, leaks, lights, plumbing, AC/heat/HVAC, doors and locks, pool equipment, fitness equipment, damage), staff submit a work order to the Facilities team through Eptura, our work order system.

Submit a work order here (no login needed): [Submit an Eptura work order](https://tucsonymcaevo.managerpluscloud.com/lt/portals/Requests/main/open)

ALWAYS give staff this exact link (it works on a phone or computer). If the Eptura Work Order Flow Charts PDF shows a different link or QR code, use this link instead — it's the current one. Include the branch, the exact location (room/area), what's wrong, and a photo if you can, so Facilities can find and fix it quickly.

If it's an emergency or a safety hazard (flooding, gas smell, no power, anything that could hurt someone), keep people away from it and tell the manager on duty / Executive Director right away — then also submit the work order so it's tracked.

Source: RJ Bergman (VP of Operations), email "Eptura: work order system", Sept 27, 2026.
